visualReview.scope: Render integrity of the current main-tower reconstruction; observatory completion remains pending.
visualReview.notes: All 14 current portable frames inspected. Bolted closed angle sections, open bar-grating stairs/landings, banded lattice, service rails, stationary RoLi carriage and top equipment are visibly coherent. The full tower and lightning-tip framing were corrected and recaptured. Real-scale thin guys undersample in distant views; no artificial thickening was applied.

sharedSurfaceReview.notes: All 14 current shared frames inspected, with full-resolution full-height, angle-joint, instrument-carriage and lightning-tip checks. Three canonical material graphs each load once. Reflective stainless equipment is darker in the shared scene than the portable fallback. Current placement transform and unloaded geometry checks pass; the flat fixture and provisional anchor blocks do not establish real terrain fit. Stored mesh triangles are 184412; instance-expanded model triangles are 737916.

geographicReview.notes: The exact-QID OSM point and published coordinate identify the main tower but differ by about 6 m. The published 202-degree lift corner determines the signed 23-degree heading. Foundation position, study guy-anchor radii/topology and real ground contacts are not independently surveyed or verified; no footprint approval is claimed.

fidelityReview.notes: The 325 m main tower is individually authored with published dimensions and component vocabulary. Exact flange/bolt/landing schedules, paint boundaries, cable-anchor topology/sag and present instrument/rescue equipment need further evidence. The independent 80/81 m companion towers and laboratory compound remain unauthored. The observatory candidate is incomplete.
